name: Oniji Itagaki
source:
Though Oniji is already the heir to the Itagaki family fortune and their fashion empire, this has not stopped him from pursuing his own successes. He apprenticed himself to various well-known tailors at a young age and assisted in the creation of over a dozen designer brands. He soon proved himself to be an accomplished seamster, a shrewd advertiser, and a capable businessman.

By the age of 22, Oniji had redefined the fashion landscape of Japan. Anyone with his level of fame would typically seek admission to one of the older Ultimate schools. However, Oniji instead chose to attend Bitokukawa, believing that it was his responsibility to bring his academy of choice to greater heights, as opposed to simply attaching his name to an already prestigious school.

With his flair for the extravagant juxtaposed with a subtle sense of humility, Oniji's path towards success will not only uplift himself, but others. His generosity in providing new couture free of charge, as well as his infectious charm, will quickly improve his reputation among his classmates.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Fanganronpa/comments/1fvugy1/meet_oniji_the_former_ultimate_tailor/]bio[/url]]
